findings.section: Functional Requirements — FR-005; Success Criteria — A-01, A-02, A-09, A-10
findings.note: The spec distinguishes approving, non-approving, missing, and malformed verdicts but defines no valid verdict vocabulary or criterion for malformed/unusable values. Specify the accepted verdict set and validation rule so tests can consistently classify valid versus invalid results and determine whether a result satisfies review requirements.
